markets.title: Will the upper bound of the federal funds rate be above 3.75% following the Fed's Jul 29, 2026 meeting?
markets.rules_primary: If the upper bound of the target federal funds rate published on the Federal Reserve's official website is greater than 3.75% following the Federal Reserve's Jul 29, 2026 meeting, then the market resolves to Yes.
